title: A Blue Whale's 188-Decibel Call Carries Hundreds of Miles Underwater

scenes.text: A blue whale's call can travel hundreds of miles underwater.
Measured at the source, the call is about 188 decibels, underwater.
It's so deep and low that humans can't hear it. It's infrasonic.
Low sounds lose very little energy in seawater, so they keep going.
Instruments have picked up calls from hundreds of kilometres away.
A whale, calling across an ocean, in a sound we can't even hear.

description:
A blue whale's call is about 188 decibels measured at the source, and can be picked up hundreds of kilometres away.
